title: Derived completeness after qcqs open extension
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-qcqs-compact-support-image-complete, the completed open extension of every integral constructible input is derived complete.

source.place: Open extension part of the completeness paragraph of the proper/open compact-support argument
source.note: Strictly smaller open factor of the compact-support image completeness statement.

proof.text: The compactification open factor is quasi-compact because f is quasi-compact. Map the unit l in the base field to global sections of X and to global sections of c.Z through c.g followed by the structure morphism of Y. This establishes exactly the two invertibility hypotheses of the existing open-completeness theorem.

Convert intrinsic derived completeness of K, which is the first part of its integral constructibility property, to unrestricted quotient completeness. The proved compactSupport_complete_iff helper uses the intrinsic/legacy comparison and an auxiliary finite field of characteristic different from l; it adds no assumption on the actual base field.

Apply the open-preservation clause of openQuotientKoszulCompleteness to c.i. It supplies a projection-normalized DVR open model O and quotient completeness of O.jShriek(K). Convert that conclusion back to intrinsic derived completeness using the same intrinsic/legacy comparison.

The proved openDvr_ringed_identification identifies O.jShriek naturally with the actual PurCompactSupport.openExtension-derived functor in the goal. Apply its component at K and the proved complete_iso helper: the natural reduction units and transitions transport the distinguished Roos triangle along this isomorphism. This proves the original statement without a new intermediate obligation.

proof_origin: E8: complete Lean proof from the already proved quotient/Koszul open-completeness assembly and the DVR-to-ringed open identification; intrinsic/legacy and isomorphism transport reuse proved private helpers. No new statements or holes.

lean.statement: theorem sfQcqsCompactSupport_open_complete (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X) : IsSfDerivedComplete l E c.Z ((openExtension (completed l E) c.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj K.obj)
